tasks.title: calculator-from-spec
tasks.prompt: In C:\Projects\calculator-test, implement a small calculator in plain JavaScript for Node.js, with no dependencies and no npm install. First read specs/README.md and specs/operations.json: they are the operator's input files — read them, never change them. Create src/calculator.js (CommonJS, module.exports) exporting add, subtract, multiply and divide. divide must throw an Error whose message is exactly the one given under errors in the specification when the divisor is 0. Create test/calculator.test.js using node:test and node:assert with one test per example in the specification, each named "<operation> <a> <b> = <result>" (for example "add 2 3 = 5"), plus one test named "divide by zero throws" that checks the exact message. Run the tests with node --test and fix anything until every test passes. Do not create package.json.

checks.name: every example of the specification is a test
the first example is a test
